title: Feed profile
description: One feed's declaration, stored in source_config.feed_profile_json: how often its deliveries are due, how large one is, where its claims are, and the thresholds the feed detectors judge it against. Whether the feed is cumulative is source_config.is_cumulative, not a field here. A detector whose fields are absent does not judge the feed.

period_type.description: The unit in which deliveries are due, JetStore's own period types.

periods_per_delivery.description: How many periods one delivery covers: 2 for every two weeks, 3 for quarterly. Absent is 1.

overdue_after_days.description: Grace, in days, after the period in which a delivery was due.

size_bytes.description: Expected size of one delivery, in bytes. Absent means the trailing band.

claim_set.description: The domain table holding the feed's claims, and the columns every content check reads.

key_columns.description: The business key, declared and never inferred.

max_service_date_lag_days.description: How far the newest date of service may fall behind the delivery.

max_service_date_span_days.description: Widest span of service dates in one delivery of an incremental feed: a row dated more than this many days before the delivery's newest date of service is outside the span.

max_out_of_span_share.description: Largest share of a delivery's rows with a date of service that may be outside the span. Needs max_service_date_span_days. Absent is 0: any row outside the span fires.

max_redelivered_share.description: Largest share of an incremental delivery's distinct keys already delivered.

required_fields.description: Columns that must be present in at least a share of a delivery's rows.
